source.name: rewirebench: MFASS v2 registered baselines, CPU run 2026-10-12
source.description: Full-protocol run of mfass-kmer-position-v2 and training-prior-v1 with the released rewirebench 0.5.0 wheel. A rerun with the project's own code and data, not an independent reproduction.

attributes.hash_scope: complete bytes of the folder's SHA256SUMS file, which lists the SHA-256 of every report, prediction and plan file in the folder

add_instruction.title: Run the registered baseline with the released wheel
add_instruction.code:
curl --fail --location --remote-name https://github.com/rewire-bio/rewire-benchmarks/releases/download/v0.5.0/rewirebench-0.5.0-py3-none-any.whl
curl --fail --location --remote-name https://github.com/rewire-bio/rewire-benchmarks/releases/download/v0.5.0/SHA256SUMS
awk '$2 == "rewirebench-0.5.0-py3-none-any.whl"' SHA256SUMS | shasum -a 256 --check
uv venv --python 3.11 .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python rewirebench-0.5.0-py3-none-any.whl
.venv/bin/rewirebench prepare mfass-v2 --source data/mfass --output prepared
.venv/bin/rewirebench run-baselines --prepared prepared --output runs/mfass-baselines

validation_receipt.source_locator: mfass-kmer-position-v2/report.json metrics: precision_at_capacity 0.61, average_precision_sklearn 0.2864, auroc 0.7779, coverage 8324/8324
